svg.title: IRB risk weights against PD, and the CRE99 Table 1 cells
svg.desc: Risk weights of the Basel III final IRB functions at maturity 2.5 years for the eight columns of BCBS CRE99 Table 1, computed by riskvalidation; the dots are the 144 printed cells. Below the 0.05% PD floor every curve is flat.
svg.text: IRB risk weight (% of EAD), Basel III final, M = 2.5 years
